source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Use diffenent version of BIOS in Primary and Backup ROM
2. AC on system and check BIOS version
3. AC off system and remove Primary ROM from MB
4. AC on system and check BIOS version again

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. BIOS version should be the version of Primary ROM when Primary and Backup ROM are install
2. BIOS version should be the version of Backup ROM when Primary is removed

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Incorrectly describes corrupting active BIOS instead of removing Primary ROM.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correct human-only conclusion but wrong stimulus (corruption rather than physical ROM removal).
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; restores distinct versions, physical removal, ESD/power and version evidence.

original_test_intent: Verify dual-ROM hardware redundancy: boot the different-version Primary ROM with both installed, remove the Primary ROM from the powered-off motherboard, then prove boot and version selection from the Backup ROM.
original_method: Validate platform ROM locations, signed version mapping and service procedure, have a qualified engineer perform AC-off verification, ESD-safe Primary ROM removal and AC-on fallback observation, then confirm Backup version and system health before powered-off restoration.
manual_activity: A qualified engineer must physically remove/reinstall the Primary ROM on the unpowered motherboard and observe both boot/version states. The agent may prepare inventories and analyze evidence but cannot perform or claim those hardware actions.
required_inputs: Exact board identity and primary/backup ROM locations/socket/module type
Two approved signed BIOS images with distinct expected versions
ESD equipment, full AC discharge/verification and qualified operator
Serial/BMC console, recovery/reinstallation and maintenance approval
safety_requirements: Do not substitute BIOS corruption, software selection or BMC power-off for physical Primary ROM removal.
Remove/insert only after complete AC removal and discharge per service procedure; never hot-plug ROM hardware.
Verify component identity and orientation before handling and stop on any ambiguity.
No automatic retry or repeated power cycle after failed fallback.
Restore hardware only while unpowered and verify final boot/BMC/OS health.
agent_execution_scope: Validate version mapping, baselines, service steps, evidence plan and recovery readiness.
Collect supplied photos/operator confirmations and console/BMC/OS version/event evidence before and after fallback.
Prepare comparison and Tool Result without claiming physical execution or engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform AC transitions, Primary ROM removal/reinstallation and ESD handling.
Observe Primary and Backup boot/version behavior and invoke board recovery if needed.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its corruption scenario is not source-equivalent and would test a different fallback mechanism.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the exact physical removal method; use read-only firmware inventory/console tools only for evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Different Primary/Backup versions, AC on/off sequence, physical removal, both criteria and 15/15-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use immutable ROM/version identities, photographed service checkpoints, independent AC-deenergized proof and time-aligned console/firmware inventory for both boot states.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Boards with physically removable Primary ROM and documented automatic Backup fallback.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board revision, ROM part/socket, BIOS image hashes, BMC/BIOS and console collector versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner-supplied motherboard service and BIOS redundancy documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds ESD, identity, deenergization, evidence and restoration controls without substituting the physical stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A corrupt-primary test or software bank switch is not equivalent to physical Primary ROM absence.

project_override_considerations: Projects may select approved version pairs but must preserve physical removal if claiming this case. Any non-physical fault injection is a separate method/coverage override.
expected_evidence: Board/ROM mapping, signed image hashes/versions, service procedure and approval
Engineer-confirmed both-ROM install, AC-on Primary version and boot trace
Full AC-off/discharge and ESD-safe Primary removal evidence
AC-on fallback boot with Backup version and system/event health
Powered-off restoration, final health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Source procedure and criteria consistently define physical Primary ROM removal and version fallback. DeepSeek's corruption wording is historical error.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Intent is clear and explicitly manual. Missing platform service inputs affect readiness rather than semantic executability.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps MANUAL ONLY but rejects its non-equivalent corruption stimulus.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with MANUAL ONLY and retains hardware identity, ESD, power and recovery controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates agent evidence support from qualified human physical operation and verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a software/corruption shortcut from replacing the exact hardware redundancy mechanism under test.
independent_technical_reasoning: Physical motherboard component removal is the core stimulus and must be performed by a qualified engineer. This is unambiguously MANUAL ONLY, independent of how much version/log collection can be automated.

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat AC, fallback or hardware removal after failure and do not attempt software/corruption substitution automatically.
